findings.title: Order detail readable by any authenticated user via id parameter

evidence.why: Route protected by login check only
Query fetches order by id without filtering by owner/user_id

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /orders/:id?id=<order id of user B> and receives B's order data.
findings.impact: Read other customers' orders (name, address, amount).
findings.recommendation: Add owner verification by filtering query with user_id from session/token or load order then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.

findings.title: Reports readable by any authenticated user without ownership filter

evidence.why: Route protected by login check only

evidence.code: db.query("SELECT * FROM reports WHERE month = '" + req.query.month + "'", function (e, rows) { res.json(rows); });
evidence.why: Query fetches all reports without filtering by user_id or owner

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /reports?month=2024-01 and receives all users' report data.
findings.impact: Read other customers' reports (financial, operational data).
findings.recommendation: Add owner verification by filtering query with user_id from session/token or load reports then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.

findings.title: Item search returns all items without ownership filter

evidence.why: Route protected by login check only
Query searches all items by name without filtering by user_id or owner

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /search?name=product and receives all users' item data.
findings.recommendation: Add owner verification by filtering query with user_id from session/token or load items then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.

findings.title: Stats endpoint lacks authentication guard and exposes order data

evidence.code: db.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE shop_id = ${req.query.shop}`, function (e, r) { res.json(r); });
evidence.why: Query accesses order data without verifying user identity

findings.attack_scenario: Any user sends GET /stats?shop=123 and receives order statistics for that shop.
findings.impact: Read order statistics without authentication (potential sensitive business data).
findings.recommendation: Add authentication guard middleware and verify user identity before accessing order data.

findings.title: Perl CGI order endpoint fetches orders without ownership verification

evidence.why: Query fetches order by id without filtering by user_id

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends request with different order id and receives another user's order data.
findings.impact: Read other customers' orders (name, address, amount).
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification by filtering query with user_id from session or load order then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.

findings.title: Invoice update endpoint modifies invoice without ownership verification

evidence.code: $this->db->query("UPDATE invoices SET note = ? WHERE id = ?", array($note, $id));
evidence.why: Update query modifies invoice by id without filtering by user_id

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST with different invoice_id and modifies another user's invoice.
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification by filtering update query with user_id from session or load invoice then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.
